purpose: Permit a transparent, metadata-selected exploratory replay of complete LH2 consequence workbooks in the reachable archive prefix without promoting the result to an external validation gate.

case_selection.rule: Use every XLSX member whose complete byte span occurs in the locally available archive prefix, as determined from TAR headers only.

allowed_analysis: read workbook sheet names, column labels and declared units
compute finite-count, timebase and channel-coverage summaries
report descriptive ranges and cross-channel availability
compare only against a separately documented bounded component model if its inputs are present
prohibited_analysis: selection or removal based on observed consequence magnitude
conversion into station-to-vehicle or site safety-distance validation
claim of complete KIT archive reproducibility while the publisher MD5 is unverified

primary_external_validation_requires: complete publisher archive byte count and MD5
all eligible cases retained, including failures

claim_boundary: This protocol permits an exploratory LH2 consequence-component replay from four metadata-selected workbook members. It cannot close any primary validation gate, establish station safety distance, validate HyRAM, or support station-to-vehicle or SAGA effectiveness claims.
